The admin password can be found by using any browser. Incidentally, the method used to find the password can also be used to link the same post multiple times on Voat without receiving an error about already posting it. Here is the url I typed in:

http://xxx.xx.xx.xxx/cgi-bin/rtpd.cgi?echo&Admin_Passwd_ss|tdb&get&HTTPAccount

Basically, there is one stored on the camera that is accessible to unauthorised users - rtpd.cgi. The question mark after the filename is a sort of break point. If you make a Voat link post and put a "?" at the end, followed by anything you like, it will post the url because it ignores everything after the question mark. But, because the url is technically different to the normal one, it recognises it as a new link, allowing you to post the same link an infinite amount of times as long as you change what you put after the question mark.

In the case of the camera though, everything after the question mark is passed straight to system and is executed as a command, meaning you can run unauthorised commands just by entering a url. I am telling the camera to give me the admin password.
